newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: JG Summit sets 15 bln pesos capital outla.
newsitem.headline: JG Summit sets 15 bln pesos capital outla.

text.p: Diversified concern JG Summit Holdings Inc said on Wednesday it has earmarked about 15 billion pesos in capital expenditure for the year.
JG Summit president James Go told a shareholders meeting that the bulk of the capital required or about six billion pesos will be used for its real estate projects.
Go added that 2.5 billion pesos will be set aside for its food business while 100 million to 200 million pesos will go to its telecommunication ventures.
The remaining amount will be used for its petrochemical and airline businesses.
Stockholders approved a one-for-four stock rights offer that will raise four billion to five billion pesos.
JG Summit chairman John Gokongwei said the firm plans to raise the required funds through debt and internally-generated cash.
